data.one_liner: Share text, files, or URIs via native share dialogs on mobile, web, and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to invoke the platform’s share sheet, supporting text, files, and URIs. On web it uses the Web Share API or falls back to downloading files.
use_when: You need to share content from a Flutter app to other apps or the system share sheet.
You want a cross‑platform solution without writing native code for each platform.
avoid_when: You need advanced sharing features like custom share targets or deep integration with specific apps.
You are targeting Linux only, as file sharing is not supported there.
strengths: Supports files, text, and URIs on all major platforms.
Web fallback downloads files if Web Share API is unavailable.
weaknesses: File sharing not available on Linux.
Requires Java 17/Kotlin 2.2.0 for Android, which may be a hurdle for older projects.
Limited customization of the share sheet beyond title and excluded activities.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, and call SharePlus.instance.share(). No special permissions needed.
